package.name: talos_mc_executor
package.description: TALOS port of the ROSCon '25 workshop's multicopter mode executor to the skybeta flight interface: wait for Offboard, take off, fly waypoints, spin 360 deg, descend to a hand-off height and hold for the pilot. Talks only to /skybeta/setpoint/pose, /skybeta/state and /visual_slam/tracking/odometry.
